acceptance_criteria.criterion: The "Stations" tab in SaveDataViewer is enabled and clicking it renders the StationsView component.
Opening the Stations tab for an extracted save with player stations shows a populated DataTable with Code, Name, Type, and State columns.
The "Show All Stations" toggle switches between [?owner=='player'] and no owner filter; row count and data update accordingly.
The class search input narrows results to stations whose class field contains the search term (debounced at 300 ms, case-insensitive via contains_i).
The name/code search input filters by station name or code (debounced at 300 ms, case-insensitive via contains_i).
Stations with state === 'wreck' display a visual amber badge in the Name column.
All column headers, filter labels, toggle labels, empty-state messages, and state labels use useI18n() — no hardcoded English in JSX.
npx vitest run reports no regressions.
detail-screens.md contains a "Stations View" section with data schema, filter descriptions, and API source — the "(Planned)" placeholder is removed.

data-flows.md contains a "Paginated Query Flow (List Screens)" section that accurately describes the shared query → filter → table pattern with all five sub-steps (trigger, filter composition, query call, state update, render).

comments.note: src/components/OwnedShipsView.tsx: The 'Role' column header is hardcoded English ('Role') rather than using t() — inconsistent with the i18n-everywhere pattern. Not blocking; flagged for awareness.

src/components/OwnedShipsView.tsx and src/components/StationsView.tsx both implement inline debounce logic (setTimeout/clearTimeout pattern). This pattern is duplicated across at minimum three list views. A shared useDebounce(value, delay) hook would reduce this duplication and eliminate any risk of inconsistent debounce timing if the delay ever needs to change globally.

src/components/StationsView.tsx: The Type column displays the raw macro string (e.g., 'station_gen_factory_base_01_macro') which is an internal game identifier. A future enhancement could strip the '_macro' suffix or apply a lookup table for friendlier display names. Not blocking for this WP — raw display is functionally correct.

notes: StationsView.tsx is implemented and wired. All 12 acceptance criteria are met. Key implementation notes for QA: (1) The class field is always empty string in live game data — the class search filter is correctly implemented but will silently return empty results when a search term is entered in the current save. This is expected behavior per plan. (2) The Type column displays the macro field (e.g., 'station_gen_factory_base_01_macro') as this is the only non-empty type information available. (3) NPC station names are empty — the component falls back to code for display. (4) The ships optional field is typed but not displayed. Smoke test recommended: open Viewer → select extracted save → click Stations tab → verify 15 player stations appear → toggle Show All → verify ~1609 total stations appear.
